note: a plain-English brief of the export-orders plan, served at REVIEW

response.headline: Kitchen staff will be able to export the day's orders as a CSV file.
changes: Add an export button to the orders list that downloads the day's orders as a CSV file.
response.approach: A coding assistant makes the edits in a working copy of your repository, in the part of the app that serves the orders list. Nothing in your repository changes until you approve and later choose to commit; pushing to GitHub is a separate question.
notIncluded: Exporting other days or other lists.
watchFor: Only one route is covered by tests, so check the export by hand.
